name: Global Safety Standards for EVs
summary:
Global Safety Standards for EVs is an immersive VR training application designed exclusively for learners enrolled in the ImmerseLearn Global Safety Standards for EVs Micro-Credential Program.

Through realistic, interactive simulations, learners gain hands-on experience with essential EV safety practices, including hazard recognition, personal protective equipment (PPE), high-voltage safety procedures, risk assessment, emergency response protocols, and compliance with global electric vehicle safety standar
